quests.name: Reclaiming the Past
quests.plugin: Wyrmstooth.esp (no other plugin edits the quest)
quests.canDoWhy: Find the abandoned Fort Valus on Wyrmstooth, then ask Lurius Liore about it and buy the deed.

needs.what: Be on the island of Wyrmstooth with Lurius Liore around, which means getting there through the Wyrmstooth quests (Wyrmstooth, then Barrow of the Wyrm)

starts.where: Wyrmstooth; once Barrow of the Wyrm is over he works by day in the East Empire Company Tradehouse in Stonehollow and sleeps there
starts.how: Find the old abandoned fort on Wyrmstooth (Fort Valus), then ask Lurius about what happened to it. He tells you its history and sells you the deed.

quests.firstStep: Ask Lurius Liore about Fort Valus

takesYou.why: the old fort you find and then buy
where Lurius works after the main Wyrmstooth story, to buy the deed and order upgrades

choices.leadsTo: The quest lists clean-up, a mess hall, armory, kitchen, bedroom, barracks, prison, garden and common house, plus hiring a crew; you go back to Lurius for each

objectives: Ask Lurius Liore about Fort Valus.
Speak to Lurius Liore about upgrading Fort Valus.

rewards.what: Fort Valus as your own fort (the deed)
rewards.when: when you buy it from Lurius

rewards.what: Fort upgrades and a hired crew
rewards.when: each time you pay Lurius for one

people.name: Lurius Liore
people.role: East Empire Company man who sells you the deed and the upgrades

unsure.why: The journal says the quest begins when you find the fort; what exactly sets it (entering the fort, discovering it on the map) isn't in these files. His deed dialogue is offered until you have bought it, so asking him first may also work, but I can't confirm it.
Lurius sits in a holding area until the Wyrmstooth scripts move him, so you can't meet him before that story starts. Whether he sells the fort during Barrow of the Wyrm or only after it isn't shown.

From his packages: after Barrow of the Wyrm he writes his ledger in the East Empire Company Tradehouse, sleeps there from midnight for 6 hours, and spends evenings from 7 pm for 5 hours at a tavern that isn't named in these files (probably The Handsome Hermit in Stonehollow). The tavern visit also depends on another quest these files don't name.
The price of the deed and of each upgrade isn't in these records. People placed at Fort Valus (a jailor, a blacksmith, workers) are probably the crew, but nothing here ties them to the upgrades.
The quest has a final hidden stage that ends it with no journal text; probably it closes once every upgrade is bought, but that isn't stated.

The records file the East Empire Company Tradehouse under a place called 'Wyrmstooth Longhouse', not under Stonehollow, so 'in Stonehollow' is likely but not confirmed. Before the story ends (from the dragon's-den part of Barrow of the Wyrm on) he hangs around Stonehollow itself.

quests.name: The Amulet of Old
quests.plugin: Journey to Baan Malur.esp (no other plugin edits the quest)
quests.canDoWhy: An Ashlander trader in Baan Malur's Arena Market has lost his family amulet and blames another trader.

needs.what: Reach Baan Malur (Journey to Baan Malur and Morrowind)

starts.where: his drinks stall in the Arena Market in Baan Malur, from 8 am for about 12 hours
starts.how: Talk to Adimmisaru of the Ahemmusa tribe; he's lost an heirloom amulet and thinks Varanie took it.

quests.firstStep: Talk to Varanie, the jeweller in the Arena Market

takesYou.why: a goblin stronghold where Varanie says the real amulet is

choices.choice: Take Varanie's fake amulet to Adimmisaru
choices.leadsTo: If he believes you, the quest is done and Varanie pays a bonus when you go back; if he doesn't, the quest fails

choices.choice: Get the real amulet from the Krettin and give it back
Sell the real amulet to Varanie
choices.leadsTo: She plans to blackmail him; the quest fails

choices.choice: Keep the real amulet and refuse them both
choices.leadsTo: No ending is written for this; the quest is left open
The quarrel is settled and the quest completes

objectives: Solve the dispute.
Search the Krettin.

closes: Adimmisaru or Varanie dies if you choose to kill one of them

people.name: Adimmisaru
people.role: Ashlander drinks seller who lost the amulet; stall in the Arena Market, sleeps from 11 pm

people.name: Varanie
people.role: Altmer jeweller in the Arena Market who has the fake and knows where the real one is; sleeps from 10 pm

unsure.why: Bulwark Krettin is known only as a cell full of goblins (chiefs, berserkers, shamans); where it lies isn't in these files.
How you travel to Baan Malur isn't covered here. The Arena Market is entered through doors from a Dragonborn cell, and the mod has a Morrowind boat-travel quest.
The gold amounts aren't in these records, and the real amulet isn't in the items index (only the 'Cheap Silver Amulet' fake, which you hand over).
Their hours come from the package time bytes, read the same way that matches named packages like WTVisitTavern19x5; their sleeping places aren't named.
